title: A top sheet with four sheet symbols: two whose files are not given, one that leaves the folder and one with no file
how: The corpus reads one file and gives the reader no loader for other files: the sheets `power.kicad_sch` and `logic.kicad_sch` cannot be read = 2 sheets that could not be read;
`../outside.kicad_sch` leaves the folder of the schematic and is never opened, and a sheet symbol with no `Sheet file` is invalid: neither is counted among the sheets that could not be read;
only the top sheet is read: 1 sheet; one wire; no part, so no net.
